need: A portable 14-inch work laptop that stays readable on site in daylight and lasts a full day away from a socket, without being uncomfortable to type on all day
must_have: comfortable to type on for hours
prefer: lasts a full working day unplugged
context: works on site two or three days a week
types for most of the working day
often no socket available until the evening
occasional photo editing in the evenings
query: portable 14 inch work laptop with a screen readable outdoors and all day battery under $1600

source_answers.almost_bought: A lighter one with a much better screen that was around $400 more.
source_answers.why_not: I carry it every day and I wasn't sure the battery would last a full day on site. The lighter one also looked like it had a shallow keyboard, and I type all day.
source_answers.never_compromise: A screen I can actually read outdoors. I work on site and a glossy panel is useless in daylight. And the keyboard has to be comfortable for eight hours.
